column1: # The schema check at start: the row platform/schema and the build's SCHEMA (the schema contract common/contracts/schema.md check; C06-SCHEMA-WIDE-32-01). The form — README.

column4: SCHEMA + 1 — the schema is newer, start refused, code 2, N in the journal
2^63 — read as an exact integer without overflow: the schema is newer with the exact N
0 < 1 — out of form, start refused, code 2
1.5 — not an integer, out of form
no row — its own SCHEMA (a fresh installation)
at of the order 1e308 (309 digits) — the time is read, start (the canon P/01.1 Н0: finite in binary64; C137-SCHEMA-TIME-01)
at «2» and 308 zeros — binary64 overflow: the row is out of form, start refused, code 2 (Г-17; MAY-UNTIL-D8-01)
